title: Tobruk instructor source transcription — two skills only

items.original: Stand in front of the sink; do not allow your uniform to touch the sink during the washing procedure.
items.rationale: To prevent contamination of the uniform

items.original: Remove jewelry and watch. Allow plain wedding band to remain in place
items.rationale:
Provides access to skin surfaces for cleaning.
Facilitates cleaning of fingers, hands, and
forearms.

items.original: Turn on water and adjust force. Regulate the temperature until water is warm.
items.rationale: Running water removes microorganisms. Warm water removes less of the natural skin oils.

items.original: Wash hands and wrist area; keep hands lower than elbows.
items.rationale:
Water should flow from the least contaminated
to the most contaminated areas of the skin. Hands are considered more contaminated
than arms.

items.original: Use about 1 teaspoon of liquid soap from dispenser or lather thoroughly with bar soap. Rinse bar soap before returning to the soap dish.
items.rationale:
Lather facilitates removal of microorganisms.
Liquid soap harbors less bacteria than bar soap.

items.original: With firm rubbing and circular motion, wash hands, the palms and back of the hands, each finger, fingertips, knuckle wrist and forearms.
items.rationale:
Friction mechanically removes microorganisms
from the skin surface. Friction loosens dirt
from soiled areas.

items.original: Wash the forearms at least as high as contamination is likely to be present.
items.rationale: Not stated in source.

items.original: Continue this friction from 10-30 seconds
items.rationale: The longer you wash, the more germs are removed.

items.original: Use finger nails of the other hand or a clean wood stick
items.rationale: To clean the area under fingernail.

items.original: Rinse thoroughly.
items.rationale: To remove the soap from the skin.

items.original: Dry hands and wrist with paper towel/hand towel: turn off the faucet.
items.rationale:
Prevents contamination of clean hands by a
less clean faucet.

items.original: Wash your hands and dry.
items.rationale: To remove microorganisms from the hand, and to prevent the spread of infection.

items.original: Pull glove out of the box with one hand.
items.rationale: Not stated in source.

items.original: Slide glove onto other hand.
items.rationale: Not stated in source.

items.original: Pull out another  with gloved hand
items.rationale: Not stated in source.

items.original: Slide glove onto bare hand.
items.rationale: Not stated in source.

items.original: Interlace fingers
items.rationale: To make gloves fit smoothly and comfortably

items.original: Removing of gloves
items.rationale: When removing gloves avoid touching the contaminated surfaces of the gloves with your bare hands.

items.original: Grip glove at base of palm
items.rationale: Avoid touching the contaminated surfaces

items.original: Pull glove off inside out
items.rationale: To contain the microorganisms inside

items.original: Slip bare fingers under wrist without touching the surface
items.rationale: Avoid touching the contaminated surfaces of the gloves with your bare hands.

items.original: Push glove down and off
items.rationale: Not stated in source.

items.original: Drop gloves in bag and seal tightly
items.rationale: To contain microorganisms

items.original: Drop the sealed bag into the trash
items.rationale: Not stated in source.

items.original: Carefully wash and dry hands
items.rationale: To remove microorganisms from the hand
